sentence_stem: If I had studied medicine at university,
correct_completion: my career would be very different today.
full_sentence: If I had studied medicine at university, my career would be very different today.
acceptable_variants: I would be a doctor now.
my life would be quite different today.

options.text: my career will be very different next year.
options.why_wrong: A future form does not fit a mixed conditional, which pairs an unreal past condition with a present result expressed using 'would'.

options.text: my career would be very different today.
my career would have been very different at that time.
options.why_wrong: This gives a past result, but the completion needs a present result, which is what makes this a mixed conditional.

options.text: university was very difficult for me.
options.why_wrong: This states a past fact instead of the hypothetical result that the if-clause calls for.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: unreal past condition with present result
explanation: The if-clause uses the past perfect to describe an unreal past situation, while the main clause uses would plus a base verb to describe its present result. Learners often copy the past form into the main clause, so check that the result refers to now.
translation: Se eu tivesse estudado medicina na universidade, minha carreira seria muito diferente hoje.
